purpose: Teach: 双眼鏡/冷や汗/有難い/北口/出だし/オリジナリティ/平地/飛び降り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、双眼鏡、絶対、で、絶対、お山、絶対、見ていたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Do you remember, Gran? When you were young, your father would look through binoculars at the mountains — really seriously, he'd do it every time.
lines.style: Quiet, gentle opening. Soft nostalgia in the voice. Unhurried pace, as though settling into old memory. Eyes warm and distant at once.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、面接の、絶対、冷や汗、絶対、ありましたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes, I do. When you were young, your grandfather used to sweat through job interviews — do you remember that, dear? Truly, he did.
lines.style: Playful glint underneath. Knowing laughter held back. She's turning his nostalgia into gentle teasing. Warm and alive in her timing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんからの、絶対、有難い、絶対、励まし、絶対、お父さん、絶対、忘れないぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, I never forgot the encouragement your father gave me — the kindness he showed. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Tender and still. Voice softens on the memory. Not performing emotion but genuinely moved. Slight hesitation, as though the feeling is fresh even now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、駅の、絶対、北口、絶対、改装、絶対、ありましたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes. When you were young, the station's north entrance — they renovated it, didn't they? I remember that clearly, dear.
lines.style: Settling into thought. Matter-of-fact but warm. She's offering her own memory in return, anchoring the conversation in shared time and place.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、商売の、絶対、出だし、絶対、苦労したぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, remember — your father struggled at the start of his business. It was hard for him then, Gran.
lines.style: Weight in the voice now. Not sad, but honest about difficulty. Slower pace. Pauses slightly before names, like he's honoring what those struggles cost.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、商売の、絶対、オリジナリティ、絶対、貫いたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. When you were young, your grandfather — he stuck to his own way in business, didn't he? Had his own originality. I remember that about him.
lines.style: Proud and certain. Voice lifts slightly on the memory of his character. No doubt in her tone. She's defending his choices to their shared past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ふるさとの、絶対、平地、絶対、農作業、絶対、手伝ったぞ、覚えてる、ばあさん?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, I remember — I helped your father with the farm work in our hometown. The fields, the labor. It stays with me.
lines.style: Measured and present. Voice lands on each memory as though placing it carefully. Quiet dignity in what he did. Breath underneath, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、川に、絶対、飛び降りる、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、無謀だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, and your grandfather — when you were young, he jumped into the river without thinking. Reckless, he was. Don't you remember that about him?
lines.style: Laughter and exasperation blended. Warm criticism. Voice brightens with affection even as she teases. Quick, alive delivery, catching his eye.
